prerequisites: six actual revision outputs are present and frozen
each usable revision output conforms to revision-output-schema.json
each revision output content hash and its M0/E1 lineage are verified
the same three held-out case bytes are assigned across matched conditions

M0_PLUS_E1: the exact raw E1 evidence file; no explicit M1 artifact
EVOLVED_M1: the frozen revision agent M1 output with its lineage
enough M0 identity and provenance to interpret that lineage

runtime_policy.matching: Use the same externally selected runtime preset across all matched conversations when operationally possible.
runtime_policy.attestation: Capture actual runtime metadata and an independent verification source where available; missing attestation lowers the claim ceiling.
runtime_policy.mismatch: Do not silently invalidate a response for runtime mismatch unless a separately frozen future protocol requires it.

allowed_visible_material: only the method/evidence inputs listed for that assignment

deterministic_build_order: preserve the opaque revision-task order in the sealed condition-map template
emit one opaque future-task manifest for each usable lineage and each of the three matched assignments
use the frozen case order assigned to that revision task for all three matched assignments
hash every visible input and reject any unlisted path
failure_policy: A missing or unusable revision output is not replaced or reconstructed. Record the missing lineage; do not fabricate M1 or held-out output. The final denominator remains six lineages for the preregistered disposition.
deterministic_task_id_recipe: TX- plus the first 12 uppercase hex characters of SHA256 over the UTF-8 string ignition-220-r0|revision_task_id|condition_label|sorted_visible_input_hashes_joined_by_LF. This maps labels to opaque IDs only inside this sealed custodian template.
